goodSentences.snippet: Ms Lin, my former English teacher, is a person who inspires me.
She began working at a small town school in 2008.
At that time, there were few English books, and many students thought English was difficult.
She collected books from friends and stayed after school every Friday to read with us.
Once, I wanted to leave because I could not understand a story.
She explained difficult words and waited patiently while I tried again.
Some students were afraid of making mistakes, so she encouraged them to read in pairs.
Her willingness to spend extra time helping us showed her patience and responsibility.
